the transferability of relational concepts is determined by the consistency of the underlying relational structure, and that the transferability is maximized by the use of autoencoders.

(1) relational transfer learning can be performed with a single autoencoder, (2) the performance of relational transfer learning is consistent and (3) the performance of the autoencoder is coherent across tasks.

1) the transferability of concepts can be measured in terms of the degree of similarity between the concept and the target task; and 2) the transferability is a non-monotonous function of the degree of concept-task similarity.

it is possible to train an autoencoder on a set of relational data, and then use it to transfer the relational structure to another set of data, without any human supervision.
